title: YourMondayMotivator: Uh oh! No idea and I'm late!
html:
Busy Monday mornings lead to this - the MondayMotivator late and me with no idea what to write about. I was thinking maybe a cute baby picture might pull me through. .... Maybe??

Did it work? So what am I doing to get the MM out with some sort of message that won't waste your time when you read it? I'm writing whatever pops into my head and then I will edit it. Seriously, whatever is popping into my mind as I'm typing. It's quite amazing what you can write when you keep typing. The words stop when I stop though. Uh-oh! Keep typing, typing, typing. Broken record time there. So you've this far and you're thinking come on Glenn there has to be a nugget in here somewhere for the time I've put into this email. There is ... “Never give in--never, never, never, never, in nothing great or small, large or petty, never give in except to convictions of honor and good sense. Never yield to force; never yield to the apparently overwhelming might of the enemy.” ― Winston Churchill Never give up, ever. Keep writing, keep practising, keep moving, keep doing and something will happen - you will finish - somewhere a long way ahead of where you started from.
